scenes.title: The stall
scenes.narration: Mia sells lemonade from a small stall. For every cup she sells, she puts one cup on the shelf. At dusk she counts the cups on the shelf. Twelve cups, twelve sales.

scenes.title: The tally
scenes.narration: The shelf is a list. Each sale pushes one cup. The count is the length of the list.

scenes.title: What to keep
scenes.narration: What to keep. One cup for one sale. The shelf is the list. Count the list, not the coins.

scenes.title: What we saw
scenes.narration: So what did we see? A small stall. A cup on the shelf for each sale. Counting at dusk. The shelf as a list. Its length is the count. Twelve sales. Next time, where did the lemons go? The ledger does not add up.
